offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures custom precision components from foam, plastics and composites for OEM customers in medical, aerospace and defense, electronics and industrial markets. Components are made to customer specifications through molding, converting, die cutting and assembly, often in cleanroom facilities.

primary_products.value: custom foam components; molded plastic components; composite components; medical device components; cleanroom packaging

primary_services.value: contract design and engineering support; contract assembly; tooling development

customer_segment.value: B2B: medical device makers, aerospace and defense contractors, electronics and industrial original equipment manufacturers

end_markets.value: medical; aerospace and defense; electronics; industrial; consumer

revenue_model.value: product sales: custom components and assemblies sold to OEM customers; project or contract: engineering, tooling and development work under customer programs

value_chain_position.value: component supplier: takes in foam, plastic and composite materials and sells finished components to OEMs; OEM / manufacturer: manufactures custom parts and assemblies to customer designs for device and equipment makers

geography_served.value: US national: customers across the United States, with manufacturing plants in several states

specialization.value: related lines: foam, plastic and composite components sold to shared OEM customer groups and using similar converting technologies

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales and engineering teams selling directly to OEM customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: medical components must meet FDA quality system rules and ISO 13485, environmental and workplace safety rules also apply
